title: NASA’s The Quiet Crew | Matt Kamlet
description: In this episode of The Quiet Crew, you’ll meet Matt Kamlet, the Communications Deputy for NASA's quiet supersonic mission. You’ll learn more about his role communicating with the public, how he got his start, and his best four-legged friend. He is part of the crew on a mission to transform aviation as NASA and communities work together to verify that the X-59’s quiet, supersonic technologies can turn a sonic boom into a sonic thump. This new technology along with a potential change in regulations will allow airliners to fly faster over land, cutting passenger travel time in half without disturbing people on the ground.    For more information about NASA's quiet supersonic mission, visit http://www.nasa.gov/X59
